usage.callShape: POST https://x402.orth.sh/context-dev/web/crawl with JSON body {url, maxPages?, maxDepth?, useMainContentOnly?, includeLinks?, includeImages?, urlRegex?, followSubdomains?}
quirks: url must include http:// or https:// protocol
To keep cost/scope minimal pass maxPages:1 and maxDepth:0 to crawl only the starting page
maxPages hard cap is 500 — a large crawl returns many results in body.results[] and may cost more
This crawl endpoint returns Markdown (body.results[].markdown); the sibling /web/scrape/html GET endpoint returns raw rendered HTML instead
usage.guide: POST a JSON body with at minimum {"url":"https://..."} to https://x402.orth.sh/context-dev/web/crawl. Pay the x402 quote (USDC on Base, ~$0.03 for a single page). To crawl just one page, set maxPages:1 and maxDepth:0; increase maxDepth/maxPages to follow links. Read the extracted content from body.results[].markdown and per-page status from body.results[].metadata; overall crawl stats are in body.metadata. No auth beyond the wallet payment.
